Signature.purpose: Loads a book's site-tree index and navigates it
Signature.description: Fetches the jsDelivr package listing from indexUrl (narrowed to scope), through a page-session cache, and resolves documents and links against it for the open docId: which folders to keep open, which node a document id or a clicked link lands on. DocsTree and MDLink bind it by the literal name `bookIndex`, so it must be mounted as Ref="bookIndex".

Prop.description: jsDelivr package listing endpoint (?structure=tree); writing it reloads the tree — write-only
Id of the open document — the base for the open path and relative links
Directory of the listing this instance serves, dropped from the node ids

State.description: Top-level nodes of the scoped site tree
Ancestor directory ids of the open document, so the tree reveals it
True while the index is loading

Method.description: Tree node for a document id
Tree node by file name — ambiguous, a last resort
